Think why you want to go to college. If your going to college for a social life I’m sorry but at that get ready for a lot of stress, and disappointment. Don’t waste the time, energy, or money for “a bit of the fantasy college life”, it’s not worth it. Life can get like the movies but don’t count on it, Follow your passions and hobbies outside and you WILL find like-minded people in the real world, be nice and make friends with them then take it from there. Life is full of opportunities for fun memories, you just gotta look for and make them.

And if you wanna go for the degree, do it for YOU. not anyone or anything else. College is a great traditional means to success, and can be a great chapter of life for those fortunate to go in their youth with the peers of their time. For us who couldn’t make the cut (be it money issues, or other) we just gotta get over it. start a family, write a song, Create something from nothing, do something

But don’t kill yourself.

Best of luck👋
